description: Searches authorized workspace leads with bounded contact, source, status, and service-interest fields; notes and estimated values are excluded. Use to search leads in the connected business. Returns query, count, leads, scope.

customer_id.description: Restrict results to a customer ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return.

query.description: Name, email, phone, source, or service interest.

urgency.description: Optional urgency: low, medium, or high.

name: search-leads

leads.description: Bounded leads records returned by this tool.

query.description: Query used or returned by this tool.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

title: Search Leads Tool
